text: Invite someone to a space: a link for one person, with a role, taken with a new or an existing account
description:
Felix 2026-11-20: strangers should not make their own accounts on the personal server; invitations are the way in. The server admin invites to the server; space owners (and managers) invite collaborators per space, new or existing users.

Built: graphs.invite gives a one-person link (14 days) that grants read, write or manage on the space. Opening it without an account offers sign-up even where sign-up is closed; with an account it is taken on login (auth.acceptInvitation) and the space opens. The space's settings list its invitations, open, expired or taken, and take them back.
